comment: Debian license short names (DEP-5) of the base image gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian13 mapped to SPDX identifiers, and the license expressions of the packages whose copyright file is not machine-readable (oec-sbom, ADR-0028 amendment C-084, decision D-1 of C-084). A short name that is not mapped here becomes LicenseRef-<package>-<name> with the exact text of the Debian copyright file. A new name without text, a copyright file that is not machine-readable and not listed in packages, or an SPDX id without images/licenses/<id>.txt fails the image build.
